title.en: Stay on one row while resolving remote infrastructure: diesel before Electric 80
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：偏远基建要先看柴油，再看电动80吗

description.en: Keep this cell as published. Yes. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery tells buyers to review diesel engine models for remote infrastructure sites. Read it in the Xingtai table. Electric 80 remains the 900 m horizontal listing only when 110 kW and ≤ 2 cm aggregate are real. Taken from the printed row: Otherwise open Diesel 30–60, LZ-60, LZ-80 or Diesel 120 and match the printed distance and output. Keep this cell as published. No country and no project name is required.
description.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：要。邢台河北品锦机械让采购方为偏远基建核对柴油机型号。只有 110 kW 和 ≤ 2 cm 骨料都成立时，电动80仍是水平 900 m 那一条。否则打开柴油30–60、LZ-60、LZ-80 或柴油120，对照已印的距离和输送量。不需要国家和项目名称。
